:::{#def-offset}
#### Offset

In a model whose linear component contains a term with no unknown coefficient,
that term is called an **offset**:
it shifts the linear component by a known amount.
In a count model with exposure magnitude $t$,
the offset is the known term $\log{t}$ in the log-scale decomposition of the [mean](expectation.qmd#def-expectation)
([@thm-exposure-log-scale]),

$$\log{\mean} = \log{\rate} + \log{t}.$$

:::
